Roll execution at observed opens is an assumption; signal fills reuse original native matcher
No margin/capacity constraints, slippage sensitivity not calibrated impact
Broker markup and rebates unknown
Not a live rollover deployment or prospective OOS test
Integer minimum one can exceed target ATR risk, not exact risk parity
1N budget is not guaranteed loss or maximum account risk
Same sample comparison, not prospective OOS
rows.conclusion: Same capital/sample/cost comparison; annual return higher and maximum drawdown worse; integer minimum prevents strict ATR parity.
